purpose: Register, before any score exists, the anchored-harness subset and the held-out comparison that S41 uses to ask whether the memory mechanism or the adapter shows a signal over the frozen base at 2,000,000 tokens. This is an intermediate instrument registration, not the WS19 bar and not a win condition.
status: INTERMEDIATE — a 2M-token signal check with an MMLU subset. The bar is docs/ws19-full-distillation-preregistration-v1.json, whose arm does not exist yet at this registration time.

relation_to_existing_registrations.rule: this file edits none of them. It fixes only the sample limits this intermediate pass is allowed to use, so a short-window table cannot be re-described after the scores as the registered full table.
relation_to_existing_registrations.anchor_deviation: the anchor pre-registration runs MMLU over all 14,042 items. This pass caps MMLU at 2,000 items to keep the six-arm window short. MMLU-Pro stays at the anchor's 36 per subject (504 items), GSM8K stays at the full 1,319, and MATH-500 stays at the full 500. Every non-limit setting (5/5/5/4 few-shot, batch 8/2/8/8, greedy decoding, seeds, 100,000 bootstrap iterations, no chat template) is the anchor's.

heldout_comparison.arm_note: adapter-20m is the S39 20M-token frozen-backbone adapter control, read from results/stage2/runs/control-20m. It is not one of the registered six arms of the full comparison; it is scored here so 10x more tokens on the same architecture is measured by the same instrument.
heldout_comparison.not_scored: full-distill, because no full-arm checkpoint exists at this registration time and no smoke or run has been launched.

anchored_subset.material_to_score: 2,000,000 tokens of distillation (adapter-2m, memory-2m) and 20,000,000 tokens (adapter-20m); the frozen base and the two memory states are controls, not token-budget arms

mmlu.limit_semantics: total items; the same stratified first-2000 the harness selects under a fixed seed

anchored_subset.reporting: per-task score and standard error, and the unweighted family means with the independent combined standard error of compare.family_means. The MMLU subset makes the knowledge mean an estimate on 2,000 of 14,042 items; every table that prints it must say so.

win_condition.registered_text: none. This pass reports a signal or its absence and does not decide a WS19 win.
win_condition.why: the token budget is 2,000,000 for the mechanism arms and there is no full-distillation arm to beat. The registered win bar is docs/ws19-full-distillation-preregistration-v1.json: knowledge mean >= 42.01 or math mean >= 39.27, and above the full-distillation control. Those thresholds are not evaluated here.
win_condition.signal_reading: a mechanism 'shows a signal' only if its family mean exceeds the frozen base by more than the combined standard error and also exceeds the parameter-matched adapter at the same 2,000,000 tokens. That is a directional observation at this budget, not a win.

what_this_file_does_not_establish: that either mechanism wins: 2,000,000 tokens is a small budget and the bar arm is absent
that the MMLU subset equals the full MMLU score: it is a 2,000-item estimate and is labelled as one
that the adapter-20m arm is a mechanism arm: it is the S39 control at 10x tokens
that any number here should be compared to the registered 42.01 / 39.27 thresholds as if it were the full table: the MMLU basis differs
